sector: Clinical skincare and personal care, actives-led, direct to consumer plus specialty retail
founded_place_size: Founded 2024 in Boston, Massachusetts. A two person founder team, sold for a year to a waiting list and through two dermatology practices before the retail season.
about: Aurelian Skin is a small clinical skincare line built on eight actives-led products at thirty four to sixty eight dollars. In March we open our own online store and enter a specialty chain's twelve doors, so everything a customer sees changes at once. The line is meant to read like a laboratory with good taste: cool, quiet, evidence first, generous with white space and free of decoration. Not a spa, not a discount aisle. Our customer reads the ingredient list before the copy, and the brand is built to reward that: honest claims, clear INCI, restraint in place of ritual.
audience: Women roughly twenty six to forty two, ingredient literate, who research formulations and trust plainness over promise. They shop web stores and specialty beauty floors and judge a product by its panel.
price_positioning: Prestige-mass at thirty four to sixty eight dollars per SKU. Above the mass aisle, below luxury conserve pricing. The middle is the position, and the look must not drift warm and cheap or dark and precious.

palette.name: Clinical White
palette.usage: The ground of every designed surface: the product-page modules, the key visual's type area and every carousel page, and the white space the brand is generous with.

palette.name: Graphite
palette.usage: Type (product names, claims, body, INCI and prices) and the 0.5 pt hairline under every product name. Never a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Cool Mineral Grey
palette.usage: Keylines, such as the keyline around an INCI panel, and small labels such as the INCI heading. Never a ground, never body text.

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.usage: Thin rules and dividers only. Never the hairline under a product name, which is Graphite, never a ground, never body text.

typography: Aurelian Skin runs four steps on screen. Step 01 is the product name in Signifier Light at 44 px on 48 px leading, set in capitals and tracked to 340 units, with a 0.5 pt Graphite hairline ruled beneath to the exact measure of the name. Step 02 is the cleared claim, also Signifier Light, at 24 px on 28 px with tracking of minus 6 units, sitting under the hairline and always reading quieter than the name. Step 03 is body in Söhne Buch 400 at 15 px on 22 px, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters a line. Step 04 is fine print in Söhne Mono 400 at 11 px on 16 px with tracking of plus 12 units and tabular lining figures, carrying INCI, percentages and prices, with the on-screen price set in the same mono at 28 px. In print the carton name is 15 pt and the INCI panel 6.5 pt. The wordmark is never rebuilt in a sans.
voice: Measured, factual, unhurried. States what a product does and does not claim. Reads like a well-run lab that respects the reader, never breathless and never coy.
brand_assets_status: The original logo file was lost when the first designer's drive failed. All that survives is a handheld photograph of an outer carton showing the mark printed in one deep ink: a small-caps lockup set around a monogram, separated by a hairline rule. Recovering that mark as usable artwork is part of this engagement. No other source brand files remain.
values: Ingredient honesty, precision in every detail from panel to package, and clinical restraint: at this band, quiet and exact is the brand, and overstatement or gloss would undercut the claim.

type_system.signature_move: Product names are set in Signifier Light capitals tracked to 340 units and ruled beneath with a 0.5 pt Graphite hairline measured to the exact width of the name, nothing wider.
rules: Never rebuild the wordmark in a sans.
Product names are always Signifier Light capitals tracked to 340 units, never another face and never another tracking value.
The Graphite hairline under a product name is 0.5 pt and runs to the exact measure of that name, never wider.
Percentages, INCI and prices sit in Söhne Mono 400 with tabular lining figures, never in the serif and never in Söhne Buch.
Body copy is Söhne Buch 400 only.
The product benefit stays visually subordinate to the product name.
State what a product does and claim nothing stronger than the cleared claim.

palette_rules.distribution: Every flat, non-photographic ground and panel is Clinical White. All type is Graphite, set on Clinical White or on a photograph's own pale sweep, apart from a small label such as the INCI heading, which may be Cool Mineral Grey. Cool Mineral Grey and Signal Blue are accents for keylines, rules and small labels, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground and never body text.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, drop shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph; type sits on Clinical White or on the photograph's own pale sweep.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gold, bronze, silver or other metallic or gloss effect, no warm tint and no dark or near-black ground in the designed areas, since the look must not drift warm and cheap or dark and precious, and no colour outside the four palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own true, corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette. The amber glass of aurelian_launch_shoot_01.jpg and aurelian_launch_shoot_04.jpg and the golden retinol drop and black ground of aurelian_actives_macro_04.jpg stay as shot; the no-gold and no-dark-ground rules govern designed elements only. The cool cast of aurelian_launch_shoot_02.jpg and aurelian_launch_shoot_05.jpg is corrected to neutral, never kept or pushed toward Signal Blue.
